overview.Description: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. is a Maryland corporation (taxed as a real estate investment trust) that focuses on owning and operating income producing retail properties with a primary focus on grocery-anchored shopping centers. Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. was founded and incorporated in 2011 in Virginia Beach, Virginia, USA.
